title: Roles and priority decide who changes what; others send change requests
rationale: Decided 2026-10-10. Owner changes anything, including roles and priorities; Engineer changes part details and CAD items; Purchaser changes supplier data and orders; Viewer changes nothing. When two members edit one field, the higher priority wins; on a tie, the app asks. Others send a change request that a higher-priority member accepts or rejects. Replaces users.can_edit_catalog.
